title: Identity-factor evaluation of the canonical finite coefficient compositor
statement: For the identity-proper compactification ci of an open immersion i:X→Z and the identity-open compactification cp of a proper map p:Z→Y, put c=(i,p). For every retained bounded-below etale-origin witness O and its fixed-scalar object M, the composite of proper support applied to the open coefficient comparison, the proper coefficient comparison, and coefficient realization of the witnessed compositor equals the proper candidate identity at open support of realization(M), proper image of the open candidate identity at realization(M), and the coefficient comparison for c. Only canonical coefficient functors and O occur: no supplied SixFunctorFiniteOperations, constructible input K, or operation comparison occurs. All objects and maps are those of [def-sf-operation-stages].

proof.text: Apply the fixed-scalar identity-factor compositor evaluation at the retained etale origin O.2.L. Naturality of identityFactorFixedIso with respect to refinementFixedWitnessIso.inv moves the input witness map past the identity-factor unit comparison. The output witness map cancels its inverse by functoriality. This identifies sixFunctorFiniteCompositionComparison with the identity-factor unit comparison at the fixed finite object M.

Apply the independent coefficient identity-unit comparison at M. The actual pair, the open compactification, and the proper compactification agree definitionally with the prescribed compactifications. The fixed realization is the canonical intrinsic derived equivalence, so this is exactly the desired equation.

proof_origin.place: J6: separate geometric identity-unit evaluation and coefficient identity-unit transport, then cancel the retained witness by naturality.

theorem finiteSupportIdentityFactorCompositor
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (C : D.CoefficientDatum)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic C.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E] (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    {X Z Y : SixFunctorSpace D} (i : X ⟶ Z) (p : Z ⟶ Y)
    (hi : IsOpenImmersion i.hom.left) (hp : IsProper p.hom.left)
    [QuasiCompact i.hom.left]
    (O : RefinementFiniteLevelOrigin C.l E n hn X.obj.left) :
    letI := hp
    letI := Padic.finite_coefficientExtensionRing C.l E n hn
    let A := Padic.coefficientExtensionRing C.l E n
    let ci := sixFunctorOpenCompactification i hi
    let cp := Compactification.ofIsProper p.hom.left
    let c := sixFunctorFactorCompactification i p hi hp (i ≫ p) rfl
    let M := refinementFiniteLevelFixedObject C.l E n hn X.obj.left O
    (sfIntrinsicCompactSupport cp A).map
        ((sfIntrinsicCompactSupportComparison A ci).hom.app M) ≫
      (sfIntrinsicCompactSupportComparison A cp).hom.app
        ((sfFixedCompactSupport A ci).obj M) ≫
      (sixFunctorFiniteRealization D C E n hn Y).functor.map
        (sixFunctorFiniteCompositionComparison C E n hn i p ci cp c O) =
    (sixFunctorProperCandidateIso A p.hom.left).hom.app
        ((sfIntrinsicCompactSupport ci A).obj
          ((sixFunctorFiniteRealization D C E n hn X).functor.obj M)) ≫
      (proEtaleConstantDerivedDirectImage p.hom.left A).map
        ((@sixFunctorOpenCandidateIso A _ _ X.obj.left Z.obj.left i.hom.left hi).hom.app
          ((sixFunctorFiniteRealization D C E n hn X).functor.obj M)) ≫
      (sfIntrinsicCompactSupportComparison A c).hom.app M
